evidence: derived from visually inspected supplied reference and V5/V6 code; prescriptions for future work are labeled normative

world.background: luminous lavender/periwinkle paper, pale center, darker edges, fine linen/grain
world.subjects: grayscale or violet-tinted cut-paper photographic/illustrative subjects with coherent perspective and ground shadows
world.composition: one dominant conceptual subject; breathing room; hierarchy before decoration
world.camera: portrait stage; near/far motion can reinforce real subject/object changes, never replace them

type.screen_text: short high-information words; kicker -> dominant noun/claim -> connective phrase

depth.near_far_plateaus: keep full subject cluster constant-depth; feather only across empty paper

constraints: no chapter-long paragraph shrunk to tiny text
no V6 lower caption pills or karaoke band
no unverified factual anecdote promoted to science/history
no new-topic reuse of Einstein narration/assets by accident
